findings.summary: The existing queued entry references an older task head; treating any present queue entry as terminal wait would strand the newly verified head.
findings.broken_invariant: Compatibility evaluator facade requires independent review evidence.

missing_tests: Stale queued head versus current provider/task head is not covered.
recovery_context: Wait only when queue branch, head SHA, base, and PR identity match current route truth; refresh an inactive stale entry with one typed enqueue and never overwrite claimed/handoff work.
